deterministic_source_audit_v1.method: Reconstruct the frozen generator exactly from source without model execution and count UTF-8 bytes/characters. All generated prompts are ASCII, so byte count equals character count.

parallel_reentry_v2.v2_design_delta: Six scenarios implement the exact target x opaque-code x query-polarity 3x3x2 factorial and share probe lexical identities across targets within each scenario.
parallel_reentry_v2.interpretation: The v2 polarity repair does not orthogonalize target from prompt/probe length. In this source-level proxy the simple length classifier becomes more predictive, 15/18 rather than 7/9, because the six-scenario exact factorial repeats the same target-specific length patterns. This is not tokenizer evidence and does not negate the value of the v2 polarity repair.

measurement_limit: Source-level byte/character length is not exact tokenizer token count. Exact Qwen tokenizer lengths must be read from the native harness prompt_tokens field at runtime or computed with the pinned tokenizer identity before holdout. The static finding is a design-confound warning, not a model-runtime result.

finding.observation: The semantic basis is estimated from the last-token layer-input activation while both v1 and the new exact-balanced v2 give semantic targets a highly predictive surface-length signature that repeats exactly across lexically disjoint calibration and holdout splits. The nuisance residualizer contains no prompt-length, token-position, probe-length or structural-shape family.
finding.mechanistic_relevance: The native capture harness tokenizes each prompt and indexes the captured layer-input row at n_tokens-1. Therefore any target-correlated tokenizer length changes the absolute sequence index of the measured state. Qwen3-0.6B exposes rotary-position parameters in its primary model configuration, so position participates explicitly in model computation.
finding.claim_boundary: This does not prove that the steering direction is a positional feature or that either runtime result must fail. It does show that label removal, lexical disjointness, opaque-code counterbalancing and exact query-polarity balance are still insufficient to identify an abstract semantic coordinate unless target is also separated from sequence length/position or the causal effect survives an exact matched-position analysis.

counterhypotheses.statement: Calibration class means partly encode prompt/probe length and the resulting last-token position, and the cvec exploits this correlated positional/surface feature rather than a reusable abstract relation state.

Counts and arrangement of punctuation/rule/fact syntax create a task-specific structural-complexity direction that transfers because calibration and holdout preserve the same target-specific grammar shape.

successor_discriminator_delta.name: POSITION_LENGTH_ORTHOGONALIZED_STRUCTURAL_GATE
required_changes: Do not alter or redispatch the frozen v1 run 32810213066; preserve it as the preregistered bounded discriminator.
Keep the v2 exact 3x3x2 target x code x query-polarity balance, but add exact tokenizer-count/last-token-position orthogonality by construction.

Bind tokenizer IDs and token counts from the pinned Qwen3 tokenizer/runtime before any successor holdout execution and fail closed if target-token-count mutual information violates the preregistered exact null criterion.
Prefer design orthogonalization over post-hoc residualization; add prompt-token-count, probe-token-count and structural-shape nuisance contrasts only as defense in depth.
Evaluate matched-position causal effects or leave-one-length-stratum-out transfer so the semantic effect cannot be supported only by the original target-specific length strata.

Retain frozen/preregistered gain, geometry-null, per-target positivity, true sign-flip reversal, off-target regression, cross-task-family transfer and replicated factorial requirements from the parent Run-2 audit.
successor_discriminator_delta.acceptance_rule: No abstract-state or canonical semantic J-Space promotion if exact tokenizer token count or last-token position predicts target above the preregistered null in calibration or holdout, unless the claimed semantic effect survives an exact position-matched causal analysis with the confound orthogonalized by design.

external_research_context.use: Primary model-family context; confirms Qwen3 and the 0.6B model scale.
Primary model configuration exposes max_position_embeddings and rope_theta=1000000 under Qwen3ForCausalLM.

external_research_context.source: Activation Scaling for Steering and Interpreting Language Models
external_research_context.use: Methodological context: steering evaluation distinguishes effectiveness and faithfulness and explicitly studies generalization over varying-length prompts; contextual evidence only.

integration_with_existing_run2.promotion_rule: R2_B9 remains additive after v2. A PASS from queued v1 run 32810213066 or a future v2 runtime result remains below canonical semantic J-Space promotion unless sequence-length/last-token-position leakage is either eliminated by design or defeated by exact matched-position causal evidence.

next_exact_action: Keep frozen v1 run 32810213066 unchanged. Treat current v2 as a valid polarity deconfound but not a promotion-ready semantic discriminator. Before any v2/successor model run, add an execution-free tokenizer/position admission audit against the pinned Qwen tokenizer/runtime identity and redesign only the successor case family until target x code x polarity is also orthogonal to exact token count/last-token position; then re-run the strict causal/generalization gates.
